description_preview:
About The Role
We are hiring a Data Engineer/AI Solution Engineer to join the Gore Performance Solution (GPS) Applied Research (AR) team and build the database architecture and AI/ML foundation needed to make Gore's materials, characterization, and fitness-for-use (FFU) data searchable, reusable, and ready for predictive analytics.
In this role, you will take end-to-end technical ownership of the Gore materials data and its supporting storage platform – from database architecture and data pipelines through cloud infrastructure, secure application access, and applied AI/ML. You will partner closely with AR scientists and engineers, the Innovation team, and GPS IT to translate materials, process, and product data and knowledge into scalable digital solutions. This role is expected to grow into a shared GPS Innovation capability supporting multiple research and NPD programs.
This position will be located at our facility in Elkton, Maryland or Newark, Delaware with the possibility of a hybrid work arrangement.
Pay And Benefits
$110,000 - $153,000 per year
Roles above $150k are eligible for the variable pay program each fiscal year, based on defined business performance metrics.
Factors considered in extending an offer within this pay range include (but not limited to) education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Medical, Dental and Vision benefits effective on Day 1 of employment! We offer a comprehensive total rewards package, including competitive benefits. More details are available at www.gore.com/careers/benefits
Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain PostgreSQL database architecture, including permissions, views, optimized query rules, and fine-grained access control.
Develop standardized Python libraries and automated data-ingestion pipelines to capture materials, characterization, and fitness-for-use (FFU) testing data at scale.
Build and maintain REST APIs and user-friendly access tools – including web applications – that make data, models, and AI-enabled tools available to scientists and engineers.
Own the platform's cloud architecture and deployment on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Container Apps and Azure Static Web Apps, plus monitoring, scaling, and production configuration.
Architect and build responsive frontend applications (Angular or React) that give researchers an intuitive, well-designed interface to data and analytical tools.
Implement authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID (App Registrations, tokens, and Entra Groups), extending role-based access control (RBAC) down to the database level.
Partner with GPS IT to integrate security groups, pipelines, APIs, and applications into enterprise infrastructure with appropriate security, access controls, and long-term support.
Set up automated CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code to enable reliable, repeatable deployment of the platform.
Design and implement AI/ML-enabled workflows – such as predictive analytics, process-structure-property models, and LLM-assisted tools – that support faster, higher-quality NPD decisions.
Translate complex materials science, characterization, and regulatory/quality requirements into structured data models, workflows, and system logic.
Collaborate cross-functionally with AR scientists/engineers, the Innovation team, and GPS IT to identify opportunities, define requirements, and deliver scalable solutions.
Document platform architecture and solutions, as well as establish reusable frameworks and standards to enable this capability to scale beyond the initial data family.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 1 year of demonstrated experience in database architecture and design, with solid proficiency in PostgreSQL, including permissions, views, optimized query rules, and access control.
Minimum of 1 year of demonstrated experience developing AI/ML models or workflow-based automation/decision-support solutions.
Software development experience in Python (or another general-purpose object-oriented language such as C or Java), and proficiency with Git.
Experience building responsive, multi-page web applications with Angular or React.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
Deep understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including configuring App Registrations, tokens, and Entra Groups for Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs, and comfort working with asynchronous execution states and data flows.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, influencing without direct authority.
Ability to travel up to 5%.
Desired Qualifications
Familiarity with materials science, characterization methods, or fitness-for-use (FFU) testing data, ideally in a regulated or advanced-materials environment.
Experience with web-based visualization tools such as vega-lite and D3, and building data-dense engineering dashboards.
Experience setting up automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
Experience writing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Azure Bicep or Terraform.
Experience with cloud data warehouses and analytics engines such as Databricks or Snowflake.
Experience with AI-assisted workflows, LLM-based tools, or prompt-driven solution design.
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
Provide sustained technical ownership and continuity for the platform as materials, data, and business needs evolve.

A cover letter is required for consideration for this position and should be attached as the first page of your resume. The cover letter should address your specific interest in the position and outline skills and experience that directly relate to this position.
Job Summary
The mission of the University of Michigan Office of the Vice President for Research (OVPR) is to catalyze, support, and safeguard U-M research. To that end, our team is constantly striving to foster new research, build partnerships, and provide support to our researchers to realize our vision of research to serve the world.
OVPR runs on systems that were never designed to talk to each other. Our small IT team supports more than thirty units, and much of what we build closes that gap: pulling identity, human resources, finance, space, and service data into one place, then replacing manual, spreadsheet driven work with software people actually want to use.
In this role you will design and build those applications. You will write the code, own the data structures behind it, and integrate against university services through the U-M API Gateway and central identity systems. You will also sit with the staff whose process you are automating and ask enough questions to understand it before you build anything. And you will use AI as an engineering tool rather than a talking point, because a growing share of what we ship is built with, or powered by, the university's generative AI platforms.
This is a small team with a wide surface. You will own work early, you will see it in production quickly, and the people using it are the ones supporting research across the university.

Design, build, and maintain web applications and internal tools that consolidate data from across the university, including OVPR's Backstage portal and its custom plugins.
Develop and consume APIs, including university services reached through the U-M API Gateway such as Finance, Department, MCommunity, and TeamDynamix.
Integrate applications with central identity services including Okta OIDC and Shibboleth, and with unit systems of record such as CollectionSpace.
Deploy and support containerized applications on the U-M Container Service.
Troubleshoot and resolve defects across the full stack, from the interface through to the data layer.
Data Architecture and Management
Model, build, and query the relational data behind OVPR applications, keeping structures clear enough that a small team can maintain them.
Aggregate data across sources that frequently disagree, including identity claims, human resources records, financial shortcodes, space and equipment data, and group memberships.
Build reporting and dashboards that answer the questions OVPR units ask repeatedly.
Apply appropriate handling for institutional data based on its sensitivity classification.
Process Automation and Applied AI
Turn documented business processes into working automation, replacing manual and spreadsheet based workflows with supported applications.
Apply the university's generative AI platforms, including the U-M GPT Toolkit and ITS AI Workflows, to automate multi step work with human review built in.
Evaluate where AI genuinely improves an outcome and where a conventional solution is the better answer.
Identify automation opportunities while working alongside unit staff, and raise them rather than waiting to be asked.
Requirements And Collaboration
Work directly with OVPR unit staff to understand how a process actually runs, not only how it is documented, and translate that into a technical design.
Partner with ITS and other technical providers on shared services, integrations, and dependencies.
Explain technical tradeoffs clearly to people without a technical background, and bring them along on the decision.
Coordinate with the IT Business Consultant and Associate Director so that consultation, project delivery, and development stay aligned.
Technical Practice and Documentation
Document applications, data structures, and integrations so that a small team can support them over time.
Contribute to code review, shared standards, and OVPR's version control practice.
Build and maintain applications in line with web accessibility standards and the university's obligations.

Working proficiency in at least one server side language such as PHP, Python, or JavaScript, with the ability to read and extend an unfamiliar codebase.

Experience with version control and collaborative development, such as Git and review based workflows.

Ability to explain technical work clearly to people who are not technical, and to gather requirements by asking questions that surface what was left unsaid.

description_preview:
Data Engineer – Insights (AI/ML)
About Our Client
Our client is a leading SaaS company with nearly three decades of experience helping energy, utility, telecom, and infrastructure companies protect their critical network infrastructure. They are now expanding their platform with new data-driven and AI-powered capabilities.
About The Role
Our client is building a new AI-driven threat and risk management platform for pipeline asset integrity. It brings together a governed, cross-product data platform built on Databricks and Azure, an AI-powered ingestion layer that normalizes, repairs, and enriches customer data, and a reusable analytical layer that runs risk models against that data. As a Data Engineer, you will build the pipelines that make this platform real. This is a new project, so you will help build it from the ground up, implementing patterns set by the Data Architect and working closely with Data Scientists on AI-assisted data ingestion. The team is US-based and works daily with colleagues in India.
Location: Remote (United States)
Schedule: Monday-Friday, with working hours that overlap with the India team, roughly 8:00-11:00 AM Eastern Time.
Employment Type: Full-time
Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for structured and semi-structured sources, including GIS, inline inspection data, SCADA, maintenance systems, and enterprise systems of record.
Implement batch and streaming ingestion using Databricks Workflows, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and declarative pipeline tooling.
Apply medallion architecture patterns (Bronze, Silver, Gold) for transformation, standardization, and enrichment.
Implement change data capture (CDC), slowly changing dimensions (SCD), schema evolution, and data-validation rules.
Normalize third-party and public data feeds (weather, soil, satellite-derived, and one-call ticket data) into the shared data model.

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.
The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.
Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.
About The Job
Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core Systems team, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of the onboard data systems.
You will work with our Core team and partner with Shore-side software engineers to build reliable data pipelines and storage systems that function in unpredictable marine environments. You will also work closely with our networking and security engineers to ensure onboard systems communicate reliably and remain free of critical vulnerabilities. Your work will directly shape how data is captured, moved, and understood onboard, enabling resilient autonomy and breakthrough operational insight for the rest of the company. As such, you should feel comfortable communicating effectively across the boundaries of teams and disciplines.
In addition to developing new capabilities, you will build on our existing development processes and tooling to further enhance the quality and reliability of our onboard software – expanding unit testing frameworks, automated integration tests, continuous deployment pipelines, and code reviews and documentation.
Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis. You will own your designs cradle-to-grave, from first concept through fabrication and deployment at sea. If you are an excellent engineer, regardless of your background, we want you to apply.
We strive to be the best engineering team on the planet and we compensate our team accordingly.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain the network-facing software layers that enable Node to communicate reliably with shore – from low-level connection handling to higher-level data exchange protocols.
Design egress pipelines that use bandwidth efficiently, weighing tradeoffs between data fidelity, timeliness, and link constraints.
Collaborate on APIs and schemas for control and data exchanges between subsystems, ensuring reliability is built in from the start.
Partner with network engineers to ensure a cohesive strategy for how bandwidth is divided and prioritized among competing data streams, ensuring consistent allocation and fulfillment of bandwidth budget.
Ensure that software degrades gracefully during connectivity loss or link degradation – including buffering, retry logic, and prioritized retransmission – so critical data isn't lost when links drop.
Work with network and security engineers to review onboard software for vulnerabilities, harden network-facing services, and ensure our interfaces meet the company's security standards before deployment.
Analyze system performance and implement optimizations for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
Extend and improve existing unit testing frameworks, integration tests, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strengthen code review, documentation, and general software engineering practices within the team.
Participate in design reviews, architecture discussions, and cross-team technical collaborations.
Required Qualifications
7+ years of experience developing software.
3+ years of experience with data-intensive or mission-critical systems.
Proficiency in a systems programming language.
Proficiency with version control.
Competency with CI/CD pipelines for automated tests and deployment.
Experience building or maintaining network-facing software – handling connection lifecycles, protocol implementation, or communication reliability in production systems.
Understanding of fundamentals in computer networking (L2–L4), transport protocols, congestion control, and distributed systems.
Experience designing systems for constrained, high-latency, intermittent, and/or expensive links (e.g., satellite, maritime, remote ops).
Familiarity with security principles for networked systems (authentication/authorization, encryption, key management).
Ability to work in a fast-paced and self-starting atmosphere.
Ability to communicate thoughtfully and empathetically with people from many different educational and professional backgrounds.
Motivation and curiosity to learn a wide variety of concepts across many disciplines, not just software engineering!
Desired Qualifications
Experience with real-time or safety-adjacent systems where reliability is critical.
Background in robotics, aerospace, or marine systems with a focus on data processing.
Familiarity with time-series databases, streaming analytics, and data pipelines for monitoring applications.
Experience with containerized build environments for developing, testing, and deploying software.
The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
The Team:
Mattel Game Studios’ mission is to harness the power of Mattel’s iconic brands and IP to create engaging, high-quality digital games.
The QA Engineer, Games Platform & Analytics, will work across our growing portfolio and partner with QA, Engineering, Analytics, Production, and external QA teams to ensure the quality of our games, integrations, and supporting systems.
The Opportunity:
Mattel Game Studios is seeking an experienced QA Engineer, Games Platform & Analytics, to provide hands-on testing and technical QA support across our mobile game portfolio.
The role will focus on supporting the quality and integrity of publishing platform integrations, analytics instrumentation, attribution, consent flows, player accounts, technical regression, and targeted build validation.
The ideal candidate has strong mobile game QA experience, is comfortable with technical teams and internal tools, and can independently investigate issues, validate data, and communicate risk.
What Your Impact Will Be
Create and maintain reusable, well-documented test cases, checklists, and validation scenarios.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing across the full slate of Mattel Game Studios titles.
Validate authentication, account linking, consent and age-gate flows for mixed-audience configurations, install and event attribution, deep links, SDKs, and platform integrations.
Validate analytics and attribution events by triggering gameplay scenarios, inspecting telemetry and payloads, verifying data integrity against expected schemas, including event taxonomy and attribution schemas, and identifying and reporting data issues.
Support time-sensitive build and data validation to supplement external QA.
Reproduce and investigate defects using logs, device data, account details, and timestamps.
Follow through with key stakeholders across Mattel’s external development partners and internal data and technology teams to investigate issues and verify fixes.
Support Internal QA sign-off for analytics, attribution, and related technical implementation.
Support the MDS Technology function by triaging internal access requests for Mattel accounts, permissions, and required tools across the product lifecycle.
Help build use cases and specs for QA tooling and process improvements, validating requirements, assessing vendor solutions, and assisting with buildout.
Serve as a secondary QA point of contact to support the MDS QA function, assisting the QA Manager as needed.
What We’re Looking For
4+ years of game QA experience, preferably in mobile or free-to-play games.
Strong hands-on Android and iOS testing experience in a game publisher environment.
Experience creating test plans, test cases, regression suites, and exploratory scenarios.
Experience testing client/server, SDK, or platform integrations, and understanding of crash and ANR reporting.
Experience validating analytics instrumentation, telemetry, or event payloads.
Strong knowledge of LiveOps, progression, game economies, account systems, and platform integrations.
Strong troubleshooting skills across client, platform, and data-related issues.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Analytics/Data, Production, and QA teams.
Ability to work independently, prioritize and escalate across projects, and provide QA leadership coverage when needed.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing Unity and/or Unreal Engine games.
Familiarity with Xcode, Android debugging tools, and mobile logs.
Familiarity with App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and test build distribution.
Experience with Mixpanel, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, or similar analytics tools.
Experience with attribution, deep linking, authentication, or consent SDKs.
Experience developing or maintaining automated tests.
Familiarity with CI/CD, mobile F2P analytics, or economy metrics.
Python scripting, C# programming experience is a plus.

Your Job
Molex is seeking a Test Engineer to support the development, validation, and qualification of advanced interconnect, cable assembly, and electronic solutions. This role will be responsible for designing and executing test plans, developing test fixtures and methods, analyzing results, and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure product performance, reliability, and compliance with customer and industry requirements. The Test Engineer will play a critical role in supporting new product development, manufacturing readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Our Team
You will join the ADS Engineering team, partnering closely with Product Design, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Reliability, and Operations teams. The team focuses on delivering innovative solutions while ensuring products meet performance, quality, and customer expectations through robust testing and validation processes.
What You Will Do
Develop and execute product verification and validation test plans for new and existing products.
Design, build, and maintain test fixtures, equipment setups, and automated test systems.
Develop and validate electrical test methods for cable harnesses and assemblies, including continuity, resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand voltage (DWV/Hi-Pot), and ESD testing, in accordance with customer, industry, and internal specifications.
Analyze test data and provide clear technical reports, recommendations, and corrective actions.
Collaborate with product development teams to troubleshoot design and manufacturing issues.
Develop, revise, and maintain test procedures, work instructions, and test department documentation.
Support qualification activities including DVP&R execution, test reporting, and design reviews.
Investigate product failures, conduct root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions.
Ensure test department and manufacturing test equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, validated, and operating effectively.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on test efficiency, automation, quality, and cost reduction.
Support customer inquiries, audits, and technical reviews as needed.
Maintain compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Who You Are
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical field.
2+ years of experience in product testing, validation, reliability, quality, or related engineering functions.
Experience using electrical test equipment such as Cirris cable and harness testers, dielectric withstand voltage (DWV/Hi-Pot) and insulation-resistance testers, ohmmeters, digital multimeters (DMMs), LCR meters, oscilloscopes, programmable power supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition systems, ESD test and monitoring equipment, and automated manufacturing test systems.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and test requirements.
Experience with Microsoft Office applications and technical report writing.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
What Will Put You Ahead
Experience with cable assemblies, connectors, high-speed interconnects, or data communication products.
Experience with automated test development, LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.
Knowledge of electrical, reliability, and environmental testing, including continuity, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand voltage (DWV), and applicable IPC-620, EIA, MIL-STD standards.
Experience with Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R) methodologies.
Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing qualification activities.
Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement experience.

These openings support CBP work. Applicants must:
Be U.S. citizens.

Build and improve security checks in development, build, and deployment workflows.

Automate repeatable security and infrastructure tasks, including work with infrastructure as code where applicable.
Troubleshoot pipeline or security-tool issues and document changes so other teams can maintain them.
Contribute to application security, cloud controls, centralized logging, or broader security improvements based on the assignment and your experience.

Approximately 1–5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, software engineering, application security, or a related technical field. We will consider the depth of your work alongside your years of experience.

Familiarity with some of the following: source control, infrastructure as code, containers, cloud services, code or dependency scanning, and application security practices.

Role:
Full Stack Developer
Location:
Remote; work must be performed within the United States. Preference for candidates located in the following states: CA, CO, DC, GA, FL, IL, MS, NC, NY, OH, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, and VT.
Type:
Full-Time, W-2
Compensation:
$75,000–$100,000 depending on experience
Experience:
3–5 years of relevant professional experience
Eligibility & Clearance Requirements
Due to federal contract requirements supporting Department of Homeland (DHS) agency programs, applicants must:
Be a U.S. Citizen.
Currently reside within the United States.
Have lived within the U.S. for at least 3 of the past 5 years.
Be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. government Public Trust clearance.
Your Route Into Full-Stack Development
Welcome to Via Logic, where innovation meets collaboration. We are seeking a Full Stack Developer with 3–5 years of professional software development experience to support our federal government client. In this role, you will contribute to the development, modernization, testing, and ongoing support of secure, large-scale applications. You’ll work across both frontend and backend components, collaborating with developers, Quality Engineers, analysts, and other technical team members to build new capabilities, enhance existing workflows, troubleshoot issues, and deliver reliable solutions.
Our development environment includes technologies such as React, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, SQL/PostgreSQL, REST APIs, AWS, Git, and CI/CD tooling. While experience with our core technologies is valuable, we are also interested in developers who bring strong full-stack fundamentals, hands-on experience with comparable modern technologies, and the ability to learn and grow within the environment. This is a great opportunity for a developer who has established a solid foundation across the application stack and is ready to deepen their technical experience while supporting meaningful, mission-driven work.
Your Mission Today
Your Responsibilities
Full-Stack Development:
Develop, enhance, and maintain secure web applications across frontend and backend components using technologies such as React, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, SQL, and related frameworks.
Frontend Development:
Build and maintain responsive, accessible user interfaces and support application workflows using modern JavaScript frameworks.
Backend Development:
Develop and support application services, APIs, business logic, integrations, and data interactions that power frontend functionality.
Application Enhancements & Modernization:
Contribute to enhancements of existing applications and workflows while supporting ongoing modernization, migrations, integrations, and backend changes.
Integration & Data Management:
Work with REST APIs, relational databases, and application data to support accurate and reliable information flow across systems.
Testing & Quality:
Partner closely with Quality Engineering to support testing strategies, validate application behavior, debug test-environment issues, and identify problems before they reach production.
Production Support & Troubleshooting:
Investigate and help resolve application issues across frontend, backend, API, integration, and data layers.
Code Quality:
Participate in peer reviews, testing, debugging, and collaborative development practices that support reliable and efficient delivery.
CI/CD & Cloud Support:
Work within cloud-based development environments and contribute to automated build, deployment, and CI/CD processes.
Security & Accessibility:
Apply secure development practices and support applicable federal security, compliance, and accessibility requirements, including Section 508.
Agile Collaboration:
Actively participate in Agile teams, sprint activities, code reviews, and cross-functional collaboration.
What Helps Explorers Succeed Here
Required Skills & Experience
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience:
3–5 years of professional software development experience.
Full-Stack Development:
Hands-on professional experience contributing to both frontend and backend components of web applications.
Frontend Development:
Experience with React, Angular, or another modern JavaScript framework, along with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript.
Backend Development:
Experience developing backend applications or services using Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, Python/Django, or a comparable modern framework.
APIs & Data:
Experience building, consuming, integrating, or troubleshooting REST APIs and working with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Troubleshooting:
Experience debugging application behavior and investigating issues across frontend, backend, integration, or data layers.
Development Practices:
Experience with Git, peer code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices.
Agile:
Experience working within an Agile development environment using Scrum, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
Communication & Collaboration:
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across development, Quality Engineering, product, and other technical disciplines.
Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience with React and Java/Spring Boot.
Experience developing or supporting applications in AWS.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, automated builds, and deployment processes.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, or related DevSecOps technologies.
Experience with automated testing and close collaboration with Quality Engineering teams.
Familiarity with secure development practices and federal standards such as FISMA, FedRAMP, and NIST SP 800-53.
Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements.
Previous federal government experience, particularly supporting DHS or USCIS.
Current or previous U.S. government Public Trust clearance.
Certifications
No certifications are required. AWS, Java, cloud, DevOps, or related

Since 1992, Kingland has been a leading provider of enterprise software products, using innovative problem solving to address many of the most complex data, risk, and regulatory compliance challenges for some of the most integral companies in the world. The Advanced Software Engineering Intern will gain experience in all aspects of the software development lifecycle and have the opportunity to develop skills using various tools and programming languages.

Title
Mid-Level Software Developer
KBR is seeking a
Mid-Level Software Engineer/Application Developer
in
Carlsbad, CA,
for long-term employment to develop breakthrough products and innovative software applications for government and commercial customers. As a software engineer, you work individually or on a small team developing software to work geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) and motion GEOINT, including electro-optical (EO; visible spectrum) and infrared (IR) imagery, imagery intelligence (IMINT), geospatial information, full motion video (FMV), moving target indication (MTI), wide area motion imagery (WAMI), hyperspectral imagery (HIS), and light detection and ranging (LIDAR). Many of our projects have an immediate impact on national security leaders' decision-making options. We need engineers who can work with full-stack development teams and handle all aspects of feature development. Hybrid work environment available, but work is primarily performed at our Carlsbad office.
Responsibilities
Work with a team lead to define software requirements
Design & develop system software for our customers
Explore new areas or program in new languages to deliver a complete product
Support on-site meetings and deliveries to customers
Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team to achieve customer and company goals
Basic Qualifications
Clearance & Citizenship: MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN.
Must have a Secret Security Clearance with TS/SCI eligibility.
Experience:
Minimum of 5 years of software development, and object-oriented design and programming, including design, coding, and testing experience
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline
Technical Acumen
Experience with Web Services and JavaScript (e.g., ReactJS)
Hands-on experience with Java, JavaScript, and C/C++
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Postgres and MySQL
AWS and Azure experience
Familiarity with Agile and/or DevSecOps procedures
Security+ or CISSP certification
Software Tester / Quality Assurance Specialist (with >2 years of experience in software testing and >1 year of experience in software quality assurance).
DevOps Engineer (with >4 years of experience in configuration control, testing, security, automation, containerization, orchestration, and cloud services open source technologies)
Contractor Product Owner (with >2 years of experience in software management and managing a backlog of requirements)
Additional Notes:
The selected applicant may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet the eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
Scheduled Weekly Hours:
40 hours/week
Basic Compensation:
$110,000-$165,000. The salary range posted is based on the national average. The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s location, knowledge, skills, abilities, and/or experience, contract affordability, and in consideration of internal parity.
Additional Compensation:
KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.
Benefits:
KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.
